CustomField.description: Case Type value (e.g. Bid Management, Legal, InfoSecurity) this mapping is further scoped to within its Record Type. Blank = applies to every Case Type within the Record Type. A Record Type can span many Case Types (e.g. Deal_Support covers Bid Management, Legal, InfoSecurity, and others), so this prevents a Case-Type-specific field from leaking onto unrelated Case Types that share the same Record Type.
CustomField.label: Case Type
